entries.title: Titus 2:1
segments: But speak thou the things which befit the sound doctrine:

entries.title: Titus 2:2
segments: that aged men be temperate, grave, sober-minded, sound in faith, in love, in patience:

entries.title: Titus 2:3
segments: that aged women likewise be reverent in demeanor, not slanderers nor enslaved to much wine, teachers of that which is good;

entries.title: Titus 2:4
segments: that they may train the young women to love their husbands, to love their children,

entries.title: Titus 2:5
segments: [to be] sober-minded, chaste, workers at home, kind, being in subjection to their own husbands, that the word of God be not blasphemed:

entries.title: Titus 2:6
segments: the younger men likewise exhort to be sober-minded:

entries.title: Titus 2:7
segments: in all things showing thyself an ensample of good works; in thy doctrine [showing] uncorruptness, gravity,

entries.title: Titus 2:8
segments: sound speech, that cannot be condemned; that he that is of the contrary part may be ashamed, having no evil thing to say of us.

entries.title: Titus 2:9
segments: [Exhort] servants to be in subjection to their own masters, [and] to be well-pleasing [to them] in all things; not gainsaying;

entries.title: Titus 2:10
segments: not purloining, but showing all good fidelity; that they may adorn the doctrine of God our Saviour in all things.

entries.title: Titus 2:11
segments: For the grace of God hath appeared, bringing salvation to all men,

entries.title: Titus 2:12
segments: instructing us, to the intent that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we should live soberly and righteously and godly in this present world;

entries.title: Titus 2:13
segments: looking for the blessed hope and appearing of the glory of the great God and our Saviour Jesus Christ;

entries.title: Titus 2:14
segments: who gave himself for us, that he might redeem us from all iniquity, and purify unto himself a people for his own possession, zealous of good works.

entries.title: Titus 2:15
segments: These things speak and exhort and reprove with all authority. Let no man despise thee.
